reason: A right-side VS Code-style workbench for the DSH Web GUI, centered on file browsing, multi-format previews, and interactive Git management with host-backed filesystem and Git services.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 提供右侧 VS Code 风格工作台，支持文件浏览、多格式预览以及 Git 更改、分支、提交和同步操作。
summaries.en: Adds a right-side VS Code-style workbench to the DSH Web GUI for file browsing, multi-format previews, and Git changes, branches, commits, and synchronization.

capabilities: reads workspace files through a host-side filesystem service
writes files when saving preview edits
stages, unstages, and discards Git changes
switches or creates branches and creates commits
pushes and pulls through the host-side Git service
streams filesystem and Git updates through HTTP and SSE
